items.title: Approve the Minutes of the May 25, 2021 Meeting Consent Agenda
Award a Three-Year Professional Services Contract, with an Option to Extend, to Eide Bailly LLP in an Amount Not to Exceed $310,000 for Annual Audit Services
Schedule and Process for Development of a New Expenditure Plan for Reauthorization of the Local Sales Tax for Transportation and Establish an Expenditure Plan Advisory Committee Structure
Resolution of Local Support Authorizing the Executive Director to File an Application for Regional Discretionary Funding with the MTC
Allocate $9,762,378, with Conditions, and Appropriate $300,000 in Prop K Funds for Ten Requests, and Allocate $926,928 in Prop AA Vehicle Registration Fee Funds for One Request
Approve the Fiscal Year 2021/22 Transportation Fund for Clean Air Program of Projects
Program $2,050,000 in Senate Bill 1 Local Partnership Program Formulaic Program Funds, Amend the Prop K/Local Partnership Program Fund Exchange, and Appropriate $1,300,000 in Prop K Funds
Adopt the Proposed Fiscal Year 2021/22 Budget and Work Program
Approve the Revised Administrative Code, Debt, Fiscal, and Investment Policies
Authorize the Executive Director to Execute Master Agreement, Program Supplements and Fund Transfer Agreements-Thereto with the California DoT for State-Funded Transit Projects
Internal Accounting Report and Investment Report (9 months)
Update on the Pennsylvania Avenue Extension Project
